# The jason commands the desktop's chat runs without asking, one per line: every verb of the CLI that the deny list
# does not cover, but doctor, which writes its bundle to any path and so goes to the person's card at every use.
#
# Written from the CLI's command tree and chat-deny-list.txt by DesktopDenyListTests; a verb added to the CLI is red
# there until JASON_UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 writes this file again. Do not edit it by hand.
